notes.title: ShantyTown Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Want to build cozy urban environments? Well, you're in the right spot. 

The ShantyTown Demo is Here!

What is ShantyTown?
ShantyTown is a relaxing urban diorama building game with a bit of a twist. Unlike other casual creation games, ShantyTown guides you with objectives and a curated set of objects to place at each location. While you play, you'll be discovering what the location is! Could it be a dockside tea house, a nightlife district or seafood market?

[previewyoutube=k7todrk_8z4;full][/previewyoutube]

Jump into the first few missions of this demo and feel the vibes for yourself!

What's in the Demo?

The ShantyTown Demo includes 5 maps including 2 major destinations and 3 minor ones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/52f2d7cf15b327c8e69e1eb8938b55fc3eae0416.pngThe Welcome Pier: Learn how to play the game in this tutorial level

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/95cd9729d0fb4966dc3498b2854daee28412bef5.pngThe Shrine: Just a bit of fun in the grass before the real game starts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/d1aae4f1eea6db47875374d7a06e8ce2d272c3a8.pngThe Lighthouse: Stack your houses, cafes and restaurants on this tiny peninsula above the water below

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/cbf2d3783634ed1784c1b8a95dbb6772f66e1526.pngCrosswaters: A stopover point for boat traffic and a hub to many other locations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/748782e38ab2a0732fb0bbd261f9802d776d5523.pngMarshlands Pipe: Built into the side of a transportation tunnel, this is a nightlife district soaked in neon lights

How Can I Help?

Want to help shape the development of ShantyTown for the better? That would be wonderful!

I'm a solo developer and I need all the help I can get.
The best way you can improve this game is to join the Discord server and share your thoughts with me directly there. 

Otherwise, there's a feedback form at the end of each level. Please share your honest opinions! I'd love to hear them. 

Thanks for the support and I hope you enjoy ShantyTown!
-Dev

notes.title: New Playtest Map: Seafood Market
notes.content:
New Map: Seafood Market
Who doesn't love miscellaneous seafood? Possibly fished from a marsh? Mmm Tasty...
This is one of the intermediate locations that is not required and not even on a path to other required stops so it's totally optional. The main reward for visiting this location is seeing unique content.

Adding Music?
That's right, I'm working on a music system in ShantyTown that adjusts based on how you're playing. Right now the only location with an available musical track is the Lighthouse map, please check it out and let me know what you think!

As usual I'll also be adding a few more people to the playtest so if you get the email, welcome!
Please try it out and let me know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/8c028ae431e70bb939177f76d00a849d74ea949d.png

If you want to learn more about the playtest, check out the event.

Please share general feedback here and more map specific feedback here and bug reports here.

Changes:

 Updated all pages of the dossier
 Added music at the Lighthouse
 Esc now cancels placement
 Testing a new “rewards” system when upgrading buildings
 Added new "unique" items


Fixes:

 Hopefully fixed some placement issues at Shanty Town


Thanks for joining the playtest of ShantyTown!
-Erik

notes.title: New Playtest Map: Shanty Town
notes.content:
New Map: Shanty Town
Yes, that's right, the map has the same name as the game!
But this was the map that inspired the game itself, before the entire world was built. You can see a bit more of what the game looked like before the world was added in this devlog.

I'll also be adding a few more people to the playtest so if you get the email, welcome!
Please try it out and let me know what you think!

notes.title: ShantyTown Playtests have Begun!
notes.content:
Hello all!
As ShantyTown's development is in a pretty good spot, I've decided it's finally time to share the game, and more importantly, get player feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370077/c463040efe52d6d268ace166fb1426438996bf34.png

Here's the deal:
I'm going to grant access to the first 100 playtesters today! Those playtesters will only have access to the first 3 maps of the game to play as much as they want.

Every couple of weeks
I'll add a few more people to the playtest alongside another map to try out as well as whatever new updates come with it. I'll keep you informed with what's included in each of those updates as they come.

If you didn't get access yet?
Don't worry, there will be plenty of chances in the future!

Want to sign up for the playtest?
You can on the Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434600/ShantyTown/

Want to wait until the game is actually done?
Great! Just hang around and I'll let you know when it's all ready for you :)

I'm really excited for this step, and looking forward to the feedback people can provide.
Thanks and speak soon!
-Erik

notes.title: ShantyTown Devlogs!
notes.content:
Welcome to ShantyTown!
Are you interested in creating dense urban environments one piece at a time? Then you're in the right spot!

View the ShantyTown Devlogs
I’ve been working on this project for about a year, and I’m excited to share it with you! ShantyTown is a relaxing cozy game, where you will create unique, colorful, atmospheric city blocks in an unusual land.

Since the very beginning of development I've been creating devlogs for ShantyTown. Here are the 2 most recent ones:

[previewyoutube=Cjq0AOD9q5w;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=6pjHmp7qnn0;full][/previewyoutube]

Hungry for more? I try to create these monthly, and plan to keep doing so. Follow the link below to view the full playlist:

View all ShantyTown Devlogs

Sign Up for Playtesting Today!
Want to help ShantyTown reach its potential? Sign up to be a playtester today on the main Steam page.

As a playtester, you'll be one of the first to try the game and it gives you an opportunity to give critical feedback to bring the project to life. It is incredibly helpful to me as a developer to know what works, what doesn't work, what is fun, and what is not. I truly appreciate every bit of constructive feedback I receive from playtesters! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434600/ShantyTown/
